readingReview.comparison: My image-only order matches the first reader's and the script. (1) Meera is not introduced: the art resolves her role. She sits behind the reception desk with the phone and registers, in front of the patient queue. Her name is never lettered on page 1, but the source does not letter it either. This is acceptable because nothing in the dialogue depends on her name. (2) The first balloon's tail looks loose: in the composed art it ends at Meera's head and clearly belongs to her. (3) 'Let's make the rest simpler' is vague, and there is no hook: the page turn answers it immediately with the onboarding caption, and the 'how' question is the intended page-1 expectation. (4) Large empty areas: resolved by the art, which fills all three panels. No unresolved items.
